clusters.headline: President Trump Indicates Shift Toward Diplomacy With Iran Conflict
aiSummaryBullets: President Trump has stated that further military escalation with Iran is unlikely if diplomatic negotiations continue to progress.
Qatar is currently mediating discussions between the United States and Iran to address nuclear capabilities and maritime access.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
